title: Poker Knight NG v1 equity request
description: The complete accepted input surface for one deterministic Texas Hold'em equity solve.
$comment: contract_version identifies v1. Wire JSON is validated then transformed into ADR 0003 canonical case bytes; it is not the canonical serialization or hash preimage. hero_cards and board_cards are semantic sets: either wire order is accepted and canonicalization sorts card IDs ascending. Schema catches token shape, per-array uniqueness, and structural ranges. Pre-execution semantic validation MUST reject a duplicate across hero_cards and board_cards with DUPLICATE_CARD; invalid token maps to INVALID_CARD. Closed-object violations, including historical analytics/options, map to UNSUPPORTED_FIELD or UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST.

contract_version.description: Protocol contract version. Planned test: rejects every value other than v1.

hero_cards.description: Exactly two distinct canonical hero hole-card tokens. Wire order is accepted; ADR 0003 canonicalization sorts internal IDs. Planned test: exact length, token shape, and duplicate rejection.

board_cards.description: Known board-card tokens. Only preflop, flop, turn, and river lengths are legal. Wire order is accepted; ADR 0003 canonicalization sorts IDs. Planned test: allowed lengths and canonical tokens.

opponent_count.description: Validated wire string parsed exactly to integer 1..6 before ADR 0003 canonical-case uint8 emission. Canonical decimal uint8 subset forbids leading zeroes, decimal points, and exponent forms. Planned test: accepts only strings 1..6 and rejects numeric/ambiguous spellings.

requested_trials.description: Positive canonical decimal uint64 string. Upper limit floor((2^64-1)/420) prevents equity-unit overflow per ADR 0002. Planned test: decimal format and bounds.

seed.description: Explicit uint64: exactly sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits with 0x prefix; leading zeroes required. ADR 0003 uses numeric LE64(seed). Planned test: rejects uppercase, short, and non-hex forms.

backend.description: Strict requested backend; unavailable cuda MUST fail rather than fall back. Planned test: rejects unrecognized backend.

rng.description: Explicit sampler identity. Unsupported identity/version is rejected before execution with UNSUPPORTED_RNG. Planned test: closed object and exact ADR 0003 identity.

algorithm_version.description: Canonical decimal version token, parsed to the internal version integer only after schema validation.

trialCount.$comment: Lexical canonical positive decimal bound through 43920819223117980; implementations additionally parse uint64 and perform resource admission.
